title: EHS Supervisor (environmental)
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).



Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure project activities follow local, state, and federal environmental regulations and company EHS standards.
  • Identify potential environmental hazards before and during project execution.
  • Monitor contractor activities and enforce EHS requirements
  • Conduct routine field checks to evaluate air, water, noise, waste management practices and other EHS topics.
  • Oversee the segregation, storage, transport, and final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
  • Lead incident reporting and support investigations, ensuring corrective actions are implemented, focused on environmental events.
  • Promote environmental awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Prepare weekly, monthly, and compliance reports for management, customer and regulatory agencies (when applicable).
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Environmental, Engineering, or related fields
  • Proven experience in Environmental management within wind farm, construction, or energy projects
  • Strong knowledge of environmental management systems, effective communication, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (for multinational environments)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Especialista - Source to Pay
description:

Fundada em 1874, a Orica cresceu e se tornou líder mundial em mineração e desmonte civil, contando com uma equipe diversificada de mais de 13.000 colaboradores ao redor do mundo.

Este é um momento empolgante para se juntar a nós. Estamos moldando o futuro da mineração por meio de tecnologias digitais e automatizadas, adotando novas formas de pensar, promovendo a inovação e reinventando a maneira como trabalhamos.

O que buscamos num profissional?


Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos


Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil


A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Quais serão as responsabilidades?

  • Analisar relatórios diários do setor;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhorias (financeira e/ou operacional), para a Logística;
  • Auxiliar na performance dos diversos setores que se reportam à área de Logística;
  • Apoiar nas cotações e contratações de transportadores e autônomos;
  • Contribuir como integrador entre as áreas comercial e industrial, analisando as demandas de mercado e a capacidade de produção;
  • Apoiar no controle das atividades de armazenagem e carregamento de produtos acabados;
  • Acompanhar a movimentação diária de carregamento para o mercado interno e exportação de açúcar e álcool;
  • Apoiar na administração da entrega de produtos acabados para os clientes, bem como transferência de produtos acabados para os centros de distribuição e entre unidades, de acordo com a programação disponibilizada pelos representantes comerciais ou programação elaborada pelo gerente da área;
  • Prestar atendimento aos representantes comerciais, transportadoras, operadores portuários e clientes, disponibilizando informações e relatórios sobre as operações;


Quais são os requisitos?

  • Ensino superior em Logística, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência com análise de dados, pacote office e Power BI;


Local de trabalho

Guaraci/SP



Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 10.700 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana- de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 8 países, 36 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.600 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2024/25, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de €5,9 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas seis unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Growth & Sales Partner — Magic: The Gathering | Stealth Startup
description:

  • Proven sales experience, including prospecting, pipeline management, negotiation, and closing deals.

  • Experience in startups, gaming, or digital products, preferably in a growth or commercial role.
  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid setup in São Paulo, SP, with self-direction and accountability.

title: Sr Sales Operations Manager - SMB
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Sales Operations Manager (IC) to join our team as the strategic engine behind our SMB merchant growth. Although this position carries a Manager title, it is a hands-on Individual Contributor (IC) role at the intersection of Sales Operations, Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, and Analytics .


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect end-to-end merchant journey systems. Define clear entry/exit criteria, operational SOPs, and category-specific methodologies to drive merchant performance and BD team efficiency.
  • Write custom SQL queries to extract data, build tracking models, monitor key operational metrics for anomalies, and proactively uncover market opportunities without relying on external analytics teams.
  • Partner directly with Product and Growth teams to secure priority exposure, subsidy budgets, and strategic campaign placements for SMB merchants.
  • Conduct research into restaurant unit economics, menu composition, gross margins, menu design, and business workflows to distill strategic insights into practical operational checklists for BDs.
  • Formulate strategic recommendations, continuously refine SOPs, and deliver training and enablement materials that turn complex operational methodologies into high-impact sales execution.


Job Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Strategy, or Business Analytics within SMB SaaS, FoodTech, or Marketplace environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience querying large datasets with SQL to perform root-cause analysis, measure business impact, and drive data-informed strategies.
  • Proven track record of combining sales operations with GTM strategy—identifying key leverage points in sales processes and exploring innovative partnership/commercial models around market trends.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business logic into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), structured playbooks, and training programs for BD/Sales teams.
  • Excellent logical thinking, communication skills, and cross-departmental collaboration abilities (connecting Sales, Product, Growth, and Marketing).
  • Proficiency in English


Keeta Brazil is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities (PwD). If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know - we are here to support you.

title: Cross Border Tech Compliance Adviso
description:
Role Description The Cross Border Tech Compliance Advisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Valparaíso de Goiás, GO. This role focuses on advising SFAP community members and partner organizations on technology-related compliance requirements affecting cross-border finance and accounting activities. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring relevant regulations and standards, preparing guidance materials, and reviewing processes to ensure adherence to data protection, cybersecurity, and fintech compliance norms. The Advisor will collaborate with stakeholders to assess risk, recommend controls for technology platforms and tools, and support the implementation of compliant workflows. The role also involves conducting awareness sessions and drafting reports, policies, and procedures that are clear, practical, and aligned with applicable regulatory frameworks.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should possess strong knowledge of cross-border compliance, including regulatory frameworks relevant to finance, accounting, and technology-enabled services.
  • Candidates should possess skills in technology risk assessment, data protection practices, and cybersecurity principles related to financial systems and digital platforms.
  • Candidates should possess the ability to analyze complex regulations, interpret legal and technical requirements, and translate them into practical policies and procedures.
  • Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the capacity to prepare clear documentation, deliver training sessions, and engage with diverse stakeholders.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Relevant experience in compliance, audit, or advisory roles within finance, accounting, or fintech environments is beneficial.
  • A bachelor’s degree in law, finance, accounting, information systems, or a related field is preferred; professional certifications in compliance, risk management, or data protection are a plus.
  • Familiarity with regional and international regulatory bodies, cross-border data transfer rules, and industry best practices in governance and ethics is advantageous.

title: Freelance Content Specialist
description:
Footballco is building a next-generation football media company: one that goes deeper into distinct communities, develops original formats and intellectual property, and creates strong brands that can travel across platforms and markets.


Our multi-brand, multi-platform approach places us at the intersection of what audiences, commercial partners and traditional media companies increasingly want. We combine global scale with a deep understanding of individual fan communities and create entertainment and experiences that others cannot.


INDIVISA is central to that ambition, and we are now expanding our portfolio with a new culture-first brand designed to connect broader female audiences with sport. This is an opportunity to shape two distinct but complementary brands, and help define how the next generation of audiences discovers, experiences and connects with football and sport


About the Role


Footballco is looking for a Freelance Content Specialist to play a key role in the launch and development of Indivisa, a football media brand in Brazil.


This is an opportunity to help build a new editorial brand from the ground up, defining how it talks about football, connects with its audience and translates the biggest stories, personalities and cultural conversations around the game into compelling, platform-native content.


The Content Specialist will be responsible for the day-to-day editorial operation of the brand , with social media as the primary focus. Working closely with the project lead, they will help develop the content strategy and be responsible for turning it into editorial plans, formats and daily execution across platforms.


The role will also coordinate the day-to-day work of a designer and copywriter, ensuring the team delivers consistent, creative and high-quality content. While social media will be the priority, the wider editorial team will also contribute to articles and other content for the brand’s website.


We are looking for someone who combines strong knowledge of football with editorial judgement, creativity and a deep understanding of social media , and who is comfortable moving between planning, content creation, publishing and performance analysis.


What you’ll be doing


  • Help develop and execute the brand’s editorial and social media strategy , translating broader strategic goals into actionable content plans.
  • Own the day-to-day editorial calendar and social publishing operation , ensuring a consistent and relevant content cadence across platforms.
  • Lead content ideation around football, identifying stories, conversations, personalities, trends and cultural moments with the potential to engage Brazilian audiences.
  • Create and develop original social formats, from reactive and news-driven content to recurring franchises and larger editorial initiatives.
  • Coordinate the daily workflow of the designer and copywriter, providing clear briefs, feedback and editorial direction.
  • Write, edit and publish social content when required, ensuring accuracy and consistency with the brand’s tone of voice.
  • Plan and script short-form video and other multimedia content, working with designers, editors and other production resources when necessary.
  • Contribute to the production and editing of articles and editorial content for the website , alongside the wider content team.
  • Manage community engagement and help develop a distinctive relationship between the brand and its audience.
  • Monitor social and content performance, using data and audience insights to identify learnings and continuously improve the editorial strategy.
  • Stay on top of platform trends, emerging formats and changes in audience behaviour, identifying opportunities for experimentation and growth.
  • Identify opportunities to react quickly and creatively to breaking news, major football moments and relevant cultural conversations.
  • Support branded content and commercial projects, helping integrate partners into the brand in a way that remains credible and audience-first.
  • Work around major football moments when necessary, including occasional evening and weekend coverage.


What you have:


  • 3+ years of experience working with social media, digital content or editorial operations, ideally within sports, entertainment, culture or digital media.
  • Strong knowledge of and genuine interest in the indivisa brand , including its main competitions, clubs, players, storylines and the broader cultural conversations surrounding the game in Brazil and internationally.
  • Strong understanding of the major social platforms and what makes content successful across different formats and audiences.
  • Excellent written Portuguese , with the ability to write engaging, accurate copy and adapt tone according to platform and format.
  • Strong editorial judgement and the ability to identify which stories, conversations and moments matter to an audience.
  • A creative mindset and genuine interest in developing new formats rather than simply reproducing traditional sports coverage on social media.
  • Experience planning and managing editorial calendars and handling multiple pieces of content simultaneously.
  • Ability to brief and coordinate creative resources such as designers, writers and video editors.
  • Comfort working with social analytics and using performance data to inform editorial decisions.
  • Hands-on knowledge of content creation tools. Basic image and video editing skills are highly valued , including familiarity with tools used to quickly create or adapt social-first content.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and make editorial decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and collaborative skills, with the ability to work across editorial, creative and commercial teams.
  • English or Spanish proficiency is a plus.



Footballco is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, and will not be discriminated against based on age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, disability or any other protected category.

title: Fonoaudiólogo – Atendimento Domiciliar
description:
Quem Somos Unimed CNU Somos responsáveis pela operação nacional dos planos de saúde da marca Unimed. Comercializamos assistência médica empresarial com abrangência nacional, levando saúde e bem-estar para mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Com foco no ser humano e no cuidado, sempre buscamos maneiras de estreitar o relacionamento com os nossos colaboradores, beneficiários, clientes e parceiros, proporcionando uma experiência cada vez melhor para todos. Se você tem paixão pelo cuidar e busca uma oportunidade para atuar com foco no acolhimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time.


A Unimed CNU valoriza e apoia a diversidade. Pessoas com deficiência, pluralidades de raça, cor, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, orientações sexuais ou de idade são consideradas para todas as nossas vagas, pois acreditamos na importância de cooperar, compartilhar ideias e pontos de vistas distintos. Todos são bem-vindos.


#SomosUnilover #UnimedCNU


Missão do Cargo Realizar avaliação e tratamento de distúrbios de comunicação, linguagem, fala, audição e deglutição em pacientes em casa. Ele busca promover a independência funcional e a qualidade de vida dos pacientes, adaptando terapias ao ambiente domiciliar. Trabalha em equipe para oferecer suporte e orientação aos pacientes e familiares, visando melhorar continuamente sua saúde e bem-estar.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Realizar visitas e atendimentos fonoaudiológicos em domicílio, garantindo um cuidado integral, humanizado e com visão holística do paciente.
  • Atuar na promoção, prevenção e recuperação da saúde, com foco contínuo na avaliação do risco de broncoaspiração.
  • Conduzir ações de educação, orientação e instrução de cuidados voltadas aos familiares e cuidadores.
  • Realizar prescrições/adequações de consistência dietética (direcionando solicitações aos responsáveis) e inserir pacientes elegíveis nos programas de Medicina Preventiva.
  • Definir o plano de cuidado domiciliar e discutir intercorrências de casos clínicos complexos em conjunto com a equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Avaliar a pertinência técnica para aprovação ou prorrogação de solicitações de atendimento fonoaudiológico e emitir pareceres técnicos sempre que solicitado.
  • Registrar rigorosamente todas as evoluções e intervenções (realizadas ou não), atualizar relatórios e anexar documentos necessários para a geração de resultados.
  • Elaborar e alimentar indicadores da área, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções e melhorias para os processos do setor.
  • Participar de reuniões clínicas e cursos de atualização, além de representar a Unimed ministrando palestras e produzindo conteúdo para eventos da empresa.


Requisitos e Qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Escolaridade: Possuir ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia.
  • Experiência em: Vivência prática em ambiente hospitalar, clínica ambulatorial, atenção domiciliar ou Home Care.
  • Outros: CNH ativa e veículo próprio para a realização de visitas domiciliares.

Desejáveis / Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimentos em/Certificações: Desejável Pós-graduação em Disfagia.


Informações Adicionais

O que você terá por aqui:

  • 🩺 Saúde e Bem-Estar
  • Assistência Médica: Cobertura ambulatorial, hospitalar e obstetrícia para você e seus dependentes legais.
  • Assistência Odontológica: Planos com subsídio da empresa que atendem desde procedimentos básicos até ortodontia e próteses.
  • Convênio Farmácia: Facilidade para compra de medicamentos em rede credenciada com desconto em folha e limite baseado no salário.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): Plataforma de bem-estar com acesso a academias e aplicativos de saúde, extensivo a até 3 dependentes.
  • Alimentação e Refeição
  • Cartão Refeição: Valor creditado por dia útil trabalhado para suas refeições diárias.
  • Cartão Alimentação: Crédito mensal gratuito para auxílio nas compras de mercado.
  • Proteção e Futuro
  • Previdência Privada: Plano instituído pela empresa para auxílio na formação de reserva financeira e renda futura.
  • Seguro de Vida: Cobertura para morte e invalidez, garantindo proteção financeira para você e sua família.
  • PPR (Programa de Participação de Resultados): Recompensa anual baseada no atingimento das metas coletivas da cooperativa.
  • 🚗 Mobilidade e Trajeto
  • Vale Transporte: Disponível para deslocamento entre residência e trabalho em regime presencial ou híbrido.
  • Estacionamento: Convênios com redes de estacionamento próximas às unidades da empresa.
  • Qualidade de Vida e Parcerias
  • Day Off: Um dia de folga concedido após o seu aniversário para você aproveitar como preferir.
  • Apoio à Família: Auxílio Creche ou Babá para colaboradoras com filhos de até 16 meses.
  • Clube de Vantagens: Parcerias e descontos em instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas e opções de lazer.
  • Outras Informações: A quilometragem e o estacionamento para a realização das visitas domiciliares são integralmente custeados pela Unimed CNU.

title: Analista de Controles Internos Pleno
description:
Somos Atvos!


Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.


Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site:


#VemPraAtvos


Aqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo à participação de mulheres e PCDs.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Promover a cultura de gestão de riscos, controles internos e governança, demonstrando o valor de um ambiente de controle robusto para a tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar o mapeamento de processos junto às áreas de negócio, por meio da elaboração de fluxogramas, narrativas e identificação de riscos operacionais, controles e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Conduzir análises para identificação, avaliação e documentação de riscos em processos, sistemas e operações, contribuindo para a definição de controles adequados e aderentes às melhores práticas de mercado.
  • Avaliar a existência, o desenho e a efetividade dos controles internos, por meio de testes de desenho e efetividade, apoiando a definição de planos de ação, melhorias e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Apoiar as áreas de negócio na criação, revisão, manutenção e divulgação de documentos normativos, como políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e demais instrumentos de governança.
  • Manter atualizadas as informações sob responsabilidade da área na plataforma de GRC, garantindo qualidade, consistência e rastreabilidade dos dados.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de reportes executivos, indicadores, apresentações e materiais de acompanhamento da área, de forma estruturada e orientada à tomada de decisão.
  • Propor e apoiar iniciativas de melhoria contínua, monitoramento contínuo de controles, automação de testes e uso de tecnologia/IA para ampliar a eficiência, a cobertura e a qualidade das análises da área.
  • Atuar no atendimento e suporte às Auditorias Interna e Externa, contribuindo com informações, evidências, esclarecimentos e acompanhamento de recomendações.
  • Apoiar a gestão e atualização da matriz de Segregação de Funções — SoD dos sistemas críticos da Companhia, incluindo a discussão de riscos, exceções e controles compensatórios junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de materiais, comunicações e treinamentos relacionados a riscos, controles internos, governança, documentos normativos e boas práticas de controle.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos, identificação de riscos, avaliação e implementação ou aperfeiçoamento de controles internos.
  • Experiência com ERP SAP e vivência com ferramentas de GRC.
  • Conhecimento de frameworks e boas práticas de mercado relacionados a riscos, controles e governança, como COSO, COBIT e ISO 31000.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Inglês intermediário.


Informações adicionais:

Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido , com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.


Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energia

Na Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã . Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.


Confira o que você encontra por aqui:

  • PLR anual , de acordo com seu desenvolvimento
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Previdência privada
  • TotalPass – para cuidar da sua saúde física e mental
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Programa Indicação de Talentos Atvos – indique profissionais que compartilhem nosso propósito e seja reconhecido por isso


Aqui, crescer com consistência significa unir inovação, sustentabilidade e propósito para gerar impacto positivo nas pessoas, nos negócios e no planeta.


Se você acredita em um futuro movido por energia limpa e por gente que faz a diferença, vem transformar o amanhã com a gente.

title: Analista de Contratos Sr | Operações Bancárias
description:

title: ESPEC PROCESSOS
description:
Sobre a Mapfre

Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa global que acompanha você em todos os momentos?

Somos a Mapfre, uma das maiores seguradoras do mundo, com mais de 90 anos de história e presença em mais de 100 países. No Brasil desde 1992, oferecemos soluções em seguros, assistências, previdência, investimentos, capitalização e consórcios.

Vivemos um novo momento e acreditamos que é a hora de dar um passo à frente, não só acompanhando caminhos, mas ajudando a percorrê-los. Para que você se sinta confiante para ir aonde você for.

Somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores ao redor do mundo trabalhando para proteger o que realmente importa: histórias, pessoas e futuros — com um olhar cada vez mais humano, diverso e alinhado com os desafios da sociedade.

E quer saber de uma coisa? Será bom ter você nessa! Mapfre. Aonde você for.


Essa é a nossa pegada! Gostou? Confira os detalhes da vaga abaixo:


O que você vai fazer

A missão dessa posição é mergulhar profundamente na experiência dos clientes e compreender tudo o que ocorre por trás dela. Isso envolve explorar jornadas de ponta a ponta, conectando processos, funcionalidades sistêmicas, comunicações, regras de negócio, indicadores e, principalmente, a voz dos clientes. Mais do que desenhar mapas de jornada, buscamos um profissional que aprecie investigar, fazer perguntas desafiadoras e conectar pontos que aparentemente não têm relação. Um indivíduo capaz de transformar sinais, dados e percepções em ideias, projetos e melhorias que simplifiquem e valorizem a experiência para quem escolhe a Mapfre.


- Mapear pontos de contato, processos, sistemas, comunicações e regras de negócio que influenciam a experiência;

- Investigar oportunidades de melhoria por meio do mapeamento, análise de dados, indicadores de satisfação, pesquisas, reclamações, feedbacks de clientes e percepções das áreas internas;

- Desenhar e acompanhar iniciativas e projetos de melhoria da experiência, garantindo que as ações gerem impacto real para os clientes e para o negócio;

- Construir narrativas e apresentações executivas que traduzam análises complexas em histórias simples, relevantes e fundamentadas em evidências;

- Documentar descobertas, mapeamentos, decisões, aprendizados e entregas, contribuindo para a criação e evolução da base de conhecimento da área.


O que esperamos de você

- Formação superior completa em Administração, Marketing, Publicidade, Design de Serviços ou áreas correlatas;

- Experiência em Customer Experience (CX), Customer Journey (Miro), CRM e Gestão de Projetos;

- Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, com conhecimento avançado de Excel para manipulação e elaboração de estudos;

- Experiência na construção de apresentações executivas e storytelling para diferentes públicos, incluindo lideranças e áreas de negócio (PowerPoint, Canva);

- Facilidade para conduzir workshops, entrevistas e discussões colaborativas com múltiplos stakeholders;

- Familiaridade com conceitos de arquitetura de dados e tecnologia, compreendendo como sistemas, bases de dados, integrações e soluções digitais suportam as jornadas dos clientes e os processos de negócio.



Nossos benefícios e cuidados com você

A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido, incentivo a saúde e qualidade de vida com Plano de Saúde, Assistência Odontológica, Auxílio Academia, Vale-Refeição, Vale Alimentação, Incentivo a Previdência Privada, Day-off de aniversário, Vale-Transporte ou Fretado, PLR, condições especiais na contratação de seguros da MAPFRE, auxílio babá ou creche, Universidade Corporativa, descontos para estudos e seguro de Vida.

Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Mais do que apoiar, celebramos cada conquista! Confira nossas ações para promover desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional e pessoal:

Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;

Mobilidade funcional e geográfica;

Avaliação de desempenho 360º;

Benefícios sociais e programas de saúde;

Projetos de voluntariado corporativo.

title: 3D Character Animator
description:
3D Character Animator - Indie Platform Fighter

I'm looking to hire an experienced 3D Character Animator to help bring the fighters in an upcoming indie platform fighter to life.

The game is a fast-paced, combat-focused platform fighter featuring gods, deities, and religious figures from different traditions battling one another. I'm looking for someone who can create dynamic, highly readable, hard-hitting combat animation , with attacks that feel powerful, responsive, expressive, and satisfying in gameplay.

What I'm Looking For

Required

  • Strong professional portfolio demonstrating 3D character animation
  • Ideally 5–10+ years of 3D animation experience
  • Experience working on indie games or other real-time game projects
  • Excellent understanding of:
  • Combat animation
  • Body mechanics
  • Weight and momentum
  • Timing, anticipation, follow-through, and impact
  • Exaggerated poses and readable silhouettes
  • Ability to create everything from quick jabs and movement animations to large, epic special attacks and finishing moves
  • Understanding of the technical constraints of animation for real-time gameplay
  • Comfortable iterating based on how animations actually feel in-game

Strongly Preferred

  • Cascadeur
  • Blender
  • Unity
  • Experience exporting animation assets and implementing/testing them inside Unity
Bonus Skills

I'd especially love to find someone capable of handling more of the full 3D character pipeline , including:

  • Retopology (for minor clean-up work)
  • UV unwrapping
  • Texturing
  • Rigging (especially for animals, or characters with multiple arms or wings)
  • Weight painting
  • Character and animal animation
  • Preparing/exporting characters and animations for Unity
  • Troubleshooting rigs, meshes, animation clips, and import settings

These additional skills are a major plus, but animation is the priority . If you're an exceptional combat animator who specializes specifically in animation, I still want to hear from you.

The Project

This is an indie platform fighter built around a roster of mythological and religious characters, with an intentionally comedic, irreverent, and satirical tone.

Important: The game contains deliberately blasphemous and sacrilegious humor and jokes about gods, religions, religious beliefs, and religious figures. Applicants need to be genuinely comfortable working on that kind of material.

Who Would Be a Great Fit

I'm looking for someone who:

  • Loves making combat animation feel ridiculously satisfying
  • Understands that gameplay readability matters as much as beautiful animation
  • Can exaggerate movement without making it feel weightless
  • Is comfortable working collaboratively and iterating quickly
  • Has experience with small or independent game-development teams
  • Can take a relatively simple stylized character and give them a huge amount of personality through movement
  • If you've worked on a fighting game, platform fighter, action game, or anything involving exaggerated character combat, I'd especially like to see it.

  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão e cross-selling de novos serviços, como AMS, BSO e PRIME, ao longo da jornada do cliente, qualificando as demandas para direcionamento à área comercial;
  • Monitorar os indicadores táticos da carteira, incluindo tempo de ciclo por etapa, taxa de normalização, SLAs e custos operacionais, reportando desvios e respectivos planos de ação à gerência da área.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Gestão de RH, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou especialização será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência consolidada na gestão de times operacionais e gestão de carteira/Customer Success em empresas B2B, como SaaS, Serviços de RH ou TI;
  • Vivência prática em gestão de crises táticas e atendimento a níveis de gerência e diretoria;
  • Domínio de indicadores de retenção e operação, como SLA, Churn, MRR/ARR, LTV, CSAT e NPS;
  • Conhecimento em processos de RH e TI e metodologias de gestão de projetos.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Conhecimentos em produtos de RH TOTVS.

title: National Sales Director (Brazil)
description:
Job Title: National Sales Director - Brazil

Reports To: Head of Overseas Business Unit

Location: Brazil (Remote, frequent travel required)


Position Overview

To support the company's strategic development, we are investing significantly in the Brazilian market to accelerate brand growth, product localization, and sales network expansion. We are seeking a National Sales Director for Brazil who will be responsible for the overall market strategy, sales planning, channel development, and team leadership. The goal is to rapidly achieve broad product coverage across Brazil and develop tailored product and sales strategies for the local market.

The ideal candidate will have established nationwide distributor and customer relationships, enabling them to contribute immediately. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience at leading baking ingredient manufacturers in a similar role.


Key Responsibilities

A. Market Strategy & Planning

  1. Develop and execute the overall sales strategy, channel plan, and annual business objectives for Brazil.
  2. Lead product localization initiatives to meet Brazilian market needs and drive product adaptation.
  3. Rapidly expand the national sales network to ensure broad market coverage.

B. Channel Development & Management

  1. Identify, negotiate with, and onboard national distributors and key strategic partners.
  2. Manage relationships with distributors and major customers, optimizing processes and service delivery.
  3. Maintain distributor and customer profiles, conduct regular performance reviews, and implement improvement plans.

C. Brand & Marketing Promotion

  1. Develop and implement brand-building activities, including marketing campaigns, PR events, and digital outreach.
  2. Organize product demonstrations, technical trainings, and industry exhibitions to increase brand visibility.

D. Cross-functional Collaboration

  1. Work closely with product, R&D, and marketing teams to share market insights and support product development.
  2. Provide training and support to distributors and customers on products, applications, and sales techniques.

E. Market & Competitive Intelligence

  1. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and regulatory changes to adjust strategies proactively.
  2. Prepare regular market reports and business forecasts for headquarters.


Qualifications

A. Experience

  1. Minimum 15 years of sales management experience in the baking ingredients industry, with a focus on non-dairy whipping toppings or related products, specifically in the Brazilian market.
  2. Previous experience in a similar role at companies is highly preferred.
  3. Established network of national distributors and key clients, with the ability to execute quickly.

B. Knowledge

  1. Full understanding of bakery products and familiarity with bakery operations or production processes.
  2. Proficient in Microsoft Office for data analysis, reporting, and presentation.

C. Competency

  1. Strong strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and business acumen.
  2. Resilient under pressure and willing to travel frequently.
  3. Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills.


We Offer

  1. Competitive compensation package.
  2. Opportunity to lead in a high-priority strategic market with significant growth potential.

With our strong independent R&D capabilities, Hi-Road meticulously sources world-class raw materials and employs advanced production technologies. Our comprehensive quality control system ensures the consistent excellence of our diverse product portfolio, which includes:

title: Collections Operations Lead – Brazil (LATAM Expansion)
description:
Ant International is a global leader in digital payments and financial technology, dedicated to connecting the world through inclusive and innovative solutions. As we expand our Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) footprint in Brazil, we are looking for an entrepreneurial Collections Operations Lead to build, scale, and optimize our local operations—with a roadmap to extend coverage across Latin America (including Mexico).


The Role

This is a high-impact, founding role within our Brazil collections team. You won't just manage existing processes—you will build them from the ground up. You will drive end-to-end execution across strategy deployment, BPO management, regulatory compliance, and cutting-edge AI tool integration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy & Operations: Design and execute the full-cycle collections strategy for BNPL in Brazil, from early-stage reminders to late-stage recovery.
  • AI & Tech Innovation: Lead the evaluation, testing, and deployment of AI-driven collection solutions (conversational AI, smart dialers) and multi-channel communications (WhatsApp, Voice, SMS, RCS).
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all operations strictly align with local laws and regulations (LGPD, BACEN, Consumer Protection Code).
  • Data Analytics & Performance: Track core KPIs (Contact, PTP, Cure, Roll, and Recovery rates), build customer segmentation models, and continuously optimize treatment strategies.
  • BPO & Partner Management: Select, onboard, and manage local BPO vendors, ensuring high performance standards and operational alignment.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Credit Risk to feed post-loan insights back into underwriting models.
  • Regional Expansion: Scale operational frameworks to support future collections setup in Mexico and other LATAM markets.


What We Are Looking For


Must-Have:

  • Fintech/Scale-up Experience: Proven track record in collections operations within leading Fintechs or high-growth consumer credit platforms in LATAM (e.g., 99, Shopee, Nubank, Mercado Pago).
  • Deep Local Market Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of Brazil’s collections landscape, BPO ecosystem, consumer behavior, and financial regulations (LGPD, BACEN).

title: Accounting Lead
description:
Position Purpose


To lead and oversee the Accounting, Fiscal (Tax), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury functions. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring accuracy, compliance, and operational and reporting excellence across all financial processes. This leader must act as a strategic business consultant, ensuring strategic alignment and supporting decision-making across the entire company.

The owner of the role is also responsible for the fulfillment of both the Grünenthal and local Codes of Conduct in the activities organized by him/her, as well as in those in which he/she participates.


Key Responsibilities

Fiscal, Tax Governance, and Credits

  • Lead the tax credit strategy, actively seeking efficient and additional tax optimization opportunities, in full compliance and alignment with corporate governance.
  • Lead the entire implementation and update of the Brazilian Tax Reform, analyzing its impacts and ensuring business continuity and compliance.
  • Manage the relationship and deliverables of external consultants (Tax).
  • Lead compliance processes with external audit firms (Big Four).
  • Ensure full operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.
  • Search for efficient tax strategies, according to corporate guidance.

Accounting, Audit, and Treasury Management

  • Oversee all Accounting (IFRS/CPCs/German GAAP), Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Treasury routines.
  • Lead and coordinate all external (Big Four) and internal audit processes, ensuring deadlines are met and recommendations are correctly implemented.
  • Ensure the accuracy and correct recording of all financial transactions.
  • Lead initiatives to optimize working capital.
  • Lead Continuous Process Improvement initiatives.
  • Manage the Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and execution of activities performed by the Shared Service Center (SSC) in Lisbon, Portugal.
  • Coordinate accounting, tax, and treasury projects and ensure their implementation according to corporate requirements.
  • Identify and establish effective procedures to safeguard company assets and ensure proper reporting to governmental entities in accordance with local legislation.
  • Manage the Other Operating Results Budget.
  • Prepare and monitor Cash Flow.
  • Ensure operational excellence and compliance in all legal and tax processes, aligned with policies, laws, and internal procedures.

Capability Requirements

Mandatory

  • University Degree in Accounting.
  • Active CRC (CPA equivalent).
  • Solid experience in Accounting and Tax Management.
  • Experience working with a Shared Service Center (SSC).
  • Experience reviewing Financial Statements.
  • Experience reviewing ECD and ECF filings.

Desirable

  • MBA or Postgraduate Degree in Finance or Controlling.

Interfaces

Internal

  • Sales

  • Finance Teams

External

  • Big Four Auditors

  • Banks
  • Tax Authorities (RFB and others)

title: Director of Procurement
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce

Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).


Key Responsibilities

1. Fully responsible for the company's procurement in the Latin American region, and for developing and optimizing regional procurement strategies.

2. Lead market research in Latin America, analyze regional industry trends, supplier capabilities, and market risks to support the company's procurement strategy and project decision-making.

3. Manage and deeply maintain the regional supplier ecosystem, regularly evaluate the quality of suppliers' products and services, and drive improvements in key supply chain systems.

4. Guide and participate in the negotiation, review, and management of procurement contracts to ensure they are legal and compliant, protecting the company's interests.

5. Develop and implement procurement cost control plans, continuously drive improvements in procurement processes, efficiency, and cost optimization to enhance project profitability.

6. Build and improve regional procurement processes, policies, and systems, promoting standardized procurement and digital advancement to achieve compliant and transparent processes.

7. Collaborate with delivery, operations, and other relevant departments, as well as headquarters resources, to effectively support the smooth execution of regional projects.


Job Requirements

  • 1. Bachelor's degree or above, preferably in a science or engineering major.
  • 2. Over 10 years of experience in procurement or supply chain management, with required experience in procurement in Latin America.
  • 3. Thorough understanding of procurement processes and cross-cultural supplier management, capable of independently leading procurement negotiations and maintaining supplier relationships.
  • 4. Strong cost awareness and data analysis abilities, with proven success in procurement cost control.
  • 5. Strong communication, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills, able to efficiently handle regional procurement emergencies.
  • 6. Highly responsible, self-motivated, big-picture thinker, able to handle pressure at key delivery milestones.
  • 7. Proficient in English, able to frequently travel across Latin American countries.
  • 8. Experience in building and managing procurement systems in the Latin American region for Fortune 500, international energy, or engineering companies is preferred.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
About VelaFi

At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States.

Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability.

Position Overview

VelaFi Brazil is seeking an independent Internal Auditor to establish and execute our internal audit framework required for Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) VASP/PSAV authorization under Resolution BCB No. 552/2025.

In this role, you will objectively evaluate the effectiveness of our governance, risk management processes, AML/CFT controls (Circular BCB No. 3,978/2020), cybersecurity measures, and cross-border payment operations.

Location

Hybrid: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit Plan & Execution: Design and execute an annual risk-based internal audit plan approved by the Board of Directors.
  • AML/CFT & Regulatory Testing: Conduct independent testing of AML/CFT controls (KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, SAR/ROS procedures).
  • Custody & Segregation Review: Evaluate asset segregation and digital asset custody controls in compliance with BCB regulations (e.g., Res. BCB 520).
  • Cybersecurity & Tech Audits: Assess IT controls, key management, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Business Continuity (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DRP) frameworks (Res. BCB 552 / Res. BCB 85).
  • Reporting & Escalation: Report findings, control deficiencies, and remediation status directly to the Board. Support mock regulatory audits and pre-filing BCB readiness reviews.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Proven experience in internal/external audit or risk assurance within financial institutions, payment institutions (IP), or licensed VASPs/crypto entities in Brazil.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Deep understanding of the BCB regulatory framework (Res. BCB 552, Circ. 3,978/2020).
  • Certifications: CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA, CPA, or equivalent credentials preferred.
  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and Portuguese.

Desired Competencies

  • Financial Controls & Governance: Strong expertise in evaluating internal control frameworks, corporate governance, operational workflows, and segregation of customer assets.
  • Regulatory Reporting & Audit Expertise: Familiarity with BCB audit requirements and regulatory systems, including Unicad (IN BCB 712/713), COSIF accounting frameworks, and AML/CFT compliance.
  • Executive Presence & Independence: Ability to report directly and present objective findings to the Board of Directors and external regulators without operational bias.
  • Strong Analytical & Decision-Making Skills: Demonstrated skill in conducting root-cause analyses, dissecting complex transaction logs, and identifying systemic control gaps.
  • High Accountability & Ownership: Results-driven approach to tracking audit remediation plans and ensuring timely resolution of audit findings.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to collaborate constructively with Compliance, Risk, Engineering, and Finance teams while maintaining strict audit independence.
  • Ability to build scalable audit infrastructure: Experience establishing risk-based internal audit methodologies, automated sampling procedures, and testing frameworks that scale from early-stage authorization to high-volume cross-border operations.

Nice to Have

  • Cross-Border & FX Audit Experience: Background auditing foreign exchange (Câmbio/eFX), international remittance rails, and multi-currency liquidity settlement.
  • Digital Assets & Crypto Auditing: Practical knowledge auditing blockchain transactions, digital asset custody (Res. BCB 520), and stablecoin flows (USDT/USDC).
  • Professional Certifications: Active CIA (Certified Internal Auditor), CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CFA, or active CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade).
  • RegTech & Automation Tools: Experience testing or auditing automated transaction monitoring, automated BACEN reporting software, and reconciliation engines.

Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)

Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including:

  • Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil.
  • Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities.
  • Hold any professional registrations or licenses required under Brazilian law to perform the responsibilities of the position, where applicable.
  • Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence.
  • Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws.
  • Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.
  • Not have been declared bankrupt or legally insolvent.
  • Not have been suspended or prohibited from serving as an executive of regulated financial institutions.
  • Meet any additional "fit and proper" requirements established by the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) and other applicable regulatory authorities.

Equal Employment Opportunity

VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing
description:
The Regional Manager, Tender Management and Pricing is responsible for leading both the pricing strategy and the tender management lifecycle across a defined geographic region. They oversee all aspects of pricing and bid management to drive competitive, margin‑conscious decisions across multimodal product lines. They partner closely with Sales, Operations, Procurement, and Carrier Management to develop aligned bid strategies and deliver winning tender responses. They build strong relationships with carriers, evaluate market conditions, and lead cross‑functional teams through complex RFQs, RFPs, and tender cycles. They develop regional pricing frameworks, establish best practices, and drive continuous improvement in pricing accuracy, tender quality, and commercial outcomes. They also provide strategic insights based on post‑tender evaluations, helping refine future pursuits and improve long‑term profitability.


Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the complete pricing and tender lifecycle, including analysis of wins/losses, pipeline performance, and regional pricing positions.
  • Develop and execute clear bid strategies in collaboration with sales, technical teams, and cross‑functional stakeholders, defining win themes, timelines, and resource needs.
  • Lead and motivate cross‑functional bid teams, assigning responsibilities, tracking deliverables, and ensuring timely, high‑quality tender submissions.
  • Conduct comprehensive reviews of RFPs, RFQs, and customer requirements to identify risks, operational considerations, and solution opportunities.
  • Manage regional relationships with air, ocean, and ground carriers, securing competitive rates and optimizing procurement strategies.
  • Develop regional pricing frameworks across multimodal services (ground, intermodal, air, ocean, contract logistics, etc.).
  • Ensure pricing outputs support profitable growth, align with target margins, and reinforce customer value propositions.
  • Partner with Operations to understand cost drivers, service capabilities, network constraints, and profitability levers.
  • Drive pricing strategy in alignment with Regional Sales leadership, ensuring consistency and commercial competitiveness.
  • Maintain visibility of regional pricing and tender pipeline performance, including turnaround time, quality metrics, and commercial outcomes.
  • Conduct post‑tender and post‑award reviews to identify lessons learned and implement continuous improvement best practices.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, competitor activity, market shifts, and procurement practices to guide strategic pricing decisions.
  • Provide training, coaching, and best‑practice guidance to regional sales and support teams on pricing tools and tender processes.
  • Support digital pricing initiatives, workflow standardization, and process optimization across regional teams.
  • All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Supply Chain, Administration, Foreign Trade, Project Management) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Certification/Licensure: Industry certifications such as CILT, CSCMP, APICS, FIATA, etc. preferred but not required.
  • Languages: English (Advanced) and Native Spanish (Advanced).
  • 3+ years of experience in pricing, tender management, and/or air/ocean freight forwarding.
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, tender documentation, bid structures, and commercial/legal frameworks.
  • Excellent organizational, planning, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving capabilities.
  • Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.
  • Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.).
  • Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on‑site setting (listed in this posting), with travel for related meetings/events.

title: Key Account Sales Director
description:
JD Industrials | Director of Key Account Sales, Brazil

Work Location : Brazil (based in São Paulo, regular nationwide business travel)


Reporting to : Latin America Regional Lead


1. Business Overview

  • JD Industrials is the B2B industrial supply chain division of JD Group. We deliver one-stop digital procurement solutions covering MRO spare parts, industrial consumables, electrical automation, tools & security equipment, production materials and other industrial goods, and implement an accompanying global expansion strategy.


  • As Latin America’s largest industrial market, Brazil hosts numerous Chinese enterprises expanding overseas in new energy vehicles, construction machinery, infrastructure engineering, mining and manufacturing, alongside major local industrial conglomerates. JD Industrials has established a local legal entity in Brazil. Leveraging cross-border supply chains, local warehousing & distribution, customs clearance fulfillment and digital procurement platform capabilities, we serve Chinese-owned factories operating in Brazil and leading local industrial clients.


  • As the lead for key account sales in Brazil, this role takes charge of local KA client acquisition, commercial negotiations and long-term account management, builds the key account sales system, and drives sustained revenue growth of industrial goods business in Brazil.


2. Job Responsibilities

  • Key Account Development & Target Delivery

Take overall ownership of acquiring Chinese overseas enterprises and large local KA clients across manufacturing, infrastructure, energy and mining sectors in Brazil. Formulate key account sales strategies and annual business plans, deliver revenue, gross profit and collection targets assigned by headquarters, and secure long-term framework bulk procurement agreements. Independently engage client procurement directors, supply chain leaders and factory management teams; oversee the full lifecycle of business opportunities, tendering, commercial negotiations and contract signing.

  • In-depth Account Management & Demand Mining

Identify procurement pain points at client factories. Combine JD Industrials’ supply chain strengths to deliver customized solutions including MRO consolidated procurement, hybrid cross-border & local fulfillment, and digital procurement services. Continuously increase wallet share among existing clients, tap incremental opportunities across multiple production sites and subsidiaries, and foster long-term strategic partnerships.

  • Local Market & Competition Analysis

Continuously research Brazil’s industrial goods market regulations, major competitors, pricing frameworks of local suppliers, industry policies and import customs requirements. Produce periodic market analysis reports, feed client demands and category opportunities back to the regional headquarters, and support optimization of localized product assortments and fulfillment solutions for Brazil.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration & Project Execution

Coordinate with local Brazil teams covering operations, supply chain, customs and finance, as well as procurement & sales teams at China headquarters. Manage end-to-end order fulfillment, delivery tracking, invoicing & payment collection, and after-sales issue resolution. Control client receivables risks to maintain healthy cash flow.

Sales Team Building & Management (0-to-1 Local Team Establishment)

Build a local Brazilian key account sales talent pipeline aligned with business progress. Set individual KPIs and performance appraisal mechanisms. Equip the team with capabilities for business development and solution-based industrial sales, and coordinate joint efforts to deliver priority projects.

  • Ecosystem Partner Development

Engage local industry associations, channel partners and logistics service providers appropriately to expand lead sources and cultivate a sound local business ecosystem.


3. Job Requirements

  • Education & Language

Bachelor’s degree or above; fluent Portuguese (mandatory for commercial negotiations); English as working auxiliary language. Proficiency in Chinese is preferred (significant advantage for engaging Chinese enterprises).

Industry Experience (Mandatory)

Minimum 8 years of B2B industrial goods key account sales or sales management experience, with deep expertise in MRO, industrial spare parts, electrical equipment, tools, security products, automation and engineering materials. Familiar with industrial bulk procurement models and factory procurement decision-making chains.

Hands-on experience operating in the Brazilian market and existing client resources in manufacturing, new energy, infrastructure and mining sectors are preferred. Prior experience serving Chinese enterprises expanding overseas is a plus.

  • Core Competencies

Proven track record of 0-to-1 overseas market development. Expertise in annual bulk procurement negotiations and framework agreement management for large conglomerates. Basic understanding of cross-border industrial trade, import customs clearance and localized fulfillment. Result-oriented mindset with strong awareness of receivables risk control.

Capable of independently managing client projects with annual transaction volumes ranging from millions to tens of millions. Adept at solution-based sales instead of pure product trading.

  • Work Location Adaptability

Long-term assignment in Brazil; able to undertake frequent inter-city business travel within Brazil. Familiar with Brazilian business culture, labor laws and trade regulations. Comfortable with cross-time-zone collaboration with China headquarters.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Working experience with Schneider Electric, 3M, Grainger, RS Components, MISUMI, major local industrial distributors or cross-border industrial supply chain companies;


  • Understanding of industrial e-commerce and digital procurement platform business models;


  • Established senior-level connections with Chinese-owned factories or local industrial conglomerates in Brazil.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst


We are looking for a Business Analyst to join a development team supporting one of our global clients in the United States. This role requires strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in distributed and multicultural environments.

The ideal candidate will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are accurately captured, documented, and translated into functional requirements that support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and effectively transfer knowledge to development teams.
  • Evaluate information collected through task analysis, business process reviews, surveys, interviews, and workshops.
  • Understand, analyze, and document functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Combine business knowledge with system understanding to create functional designs across applications.

title: Survey & Insights Analyst
description:
Your Responsibilities:

The Survey & Insights Analyst supports Lockton's enterprise survey consultancy function, partnering with business units and geographies worldwide to design, deploy, and analyze surveys that create actionable insights. This role serves as a hands-on Qualtrics practitioner and analytical partner, helping internal teams translate research questions into survey programs and actionable findings while upholding data governance and privacy standards across regions.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, build, and program surveys in Qualtrics, including logic/branching, bilingual and multi-language routing, embedded data, and distribution workflows.
  • Serve as a subject matter resource for survey methodology, question design, and data quality across a portfolio of internal and client-facing survey programs.
  • Partner with stakeholders across regions and business units to scope survey requests, define objectives, and translate business questions into effective instrument design.
  • Clean, analyze, and synthesize survey data into reports, dashboards, and presentations for management and Associates.
  • Support data governance efforts, including PII/PHI risk review, survey inventory management, and adherence to global privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).
  • Provide consulting, training, and technical support to survey requestors throughout the survey lifecycle, from intake through post-deployment analysis.
  • Monitor project timelines and maintain responsibility for delivering accurate, on-time deliverables.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical, audiences.


Other Responsibilities:

  • Provides exceptional customer service and adheres to the Lockton philosophies
  • Collaborates cross-functionally with IT PMO, Digital Office, and People Solutions teams as needed


Qualifications

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 1+ years of experience in survey research, data analysis, market research, or a related analytical field
  • Demonstrated experience building and administering surveys in Qualtrics (or a comparable enterprise survey platform) required
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel required; experience with Power BI strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data manipulation or automation preferred, but not required
  • Excellent written and spoken English proficiency required, given regular collaboration with international, multi-lingual stakeholders
  • Familiarity with survey methodology best practices, including question design and sampling.
  • Awareness of data privacy principles and regulations relevant to survey data (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) a plus
  • Ability to express complex technical concepts effectively, both verbally and in writing, to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data from multiple sources and provide clear, actionable recommendations
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple concurrent projects without sacrificing quality or accuracy
  • Comfortable working across time zones with globally distributed teams; some flexibility in working hours may be required

Apuração e fechamento de IRPJ e CSLL:

Efetuar o controle de adições, exclusões, compensações, prejuízos fiscais e bases negativas.

Suportar os fechamentos mensais, trimestrais e anuais.


Conciliação contábil:

Realizar conciliações contábeis das contas de tributos diretos.

Controlar saldos de impostos diferidos, prejuízos fiscais e bases negativas.

Analisar variações entre resultado contábil e fiscal.

Garantir a consistência das informações tributárias reportadas.

Elaborar, revisar e validar informações para ECF, MIT e demais obrigações aplicáveis.

Suportar retificações e regularizações quando necessárias.

Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos e requisitos legais.

Preparar informações tributárias para reportes locais e corporativos.

Atender demandas de Corporate, Contabilidade, Controladoria e auditorias.

Elaborar análises e suportes técnicos relacionados aos tributos diretos.

Organizar documentação suporte e evidências.

Apoiar fiscalizações e revisões tributárias quando demandado.


Acompanhamento de legislação e melhoria de processos:

Participar de projetos de melhoria contínua e automação da área.

Propor melhorias em controles, procedimentos e fluxos de trabalho.

Acompanhar alterações na legislação tributária aplicável.

Experiência em empresas tributadas pelo Lucro Real;

Vivência em fechamentos contábeis e fiscais;

Experiência em apuração de IRPJ e CSLL e análise de demonstrações financeiras

title: Human Resources Manager(Mandarin preferred)
description:
The ideal candidate will support the full scope of Human Resources responsibilities and partner with the organization on strategic initiatives. They will maintain and enhance the organization's human resources by planning, implementing, and evaluating human resources policies, programs, and practices.


Responsibilities

  1. Develop and implement the HR strategic plan for the Latin America region, and regularly prepare HR status analysis reports.
  2. Oversee recruitment for job vacancies in the Latin America region, and participate in the annual and periodic centralized recruitment organized by headquarters.
  3. Optimize the employee performance indicator system in the Latin America region, and organize and implement performance appraisals and incentive programs.
  4. Establish a local compensation system for the Latin America region, communicate and enforce compensation policies, review employee payroll, and conduct monthly headcount and labor cost statistics.
  5. In accordance with headquarters' HR management policies, build a promotion and dismissal mechanism for employees in the Latin America region, handle daily management matters, and report to headquarters for approval.
  6. Develop localized training plans for the Latin America region and organize the implementation of relevant training programs.
  7. Manage the local HR team and provide professional support and guidance for the team's daily work.
  8. Prepare the annual headcount plan, labor cost budget, and fixed asset budget.
  9. Supervise and manage the localized administrative operations in the Latin America region.
  10. Complete other ad-hoc tasks assigned by leadership.


Qualifications

  1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in HR or related management fields.
  2. Experience: 3+ years of HR management experience in Latin America.
  3. Knowledge: General business management; HR management; Latin American labor market and regulations.
  4. Skills: Proficient in writing, negotiation, and MS Office.
  5. Competencies: Strong planning, organization, coordination, analysis, communication, and interpersonal skills; excellent cross-cultural and team collaboration abilities.
  6. Special Requirements: English as working language; prior HR experience in Latin America.
  7. Preferred: Chinese language skills are a plus.


岗位简介

全面负责人力资源全模块管理工作，作为业务伙伴深度协同各部门，推动战略性人力举措落地。通过规划、执行与优化人力资源政策及项目，持续提升组织效能与人才管理水平

岗位职责

  1. 制定并实施拉美区域人力资源战略规划，定期撰写人力资源状况分析报告。
  2. 负责拉美区域岗位空缺的招聘工作，并参与总部组织的年度及阶段性统一招聘。
  3. 优化拉美区域员工绩效指标体系，组织并实施绩效考核与激励方案。
  4. 制定拉美区域属地薪酬制度，宣贯执行薪酬制度，审核员工工资，月度人员信息及人工成本统计。
  5. 依据总部人力资源管理制度，构建拉美区域员工晋升与淘汰机制，负责日常管理并报总部审批。
  6. 制定拉美区域属地化培训计划，并组织实施相关培训项目。
  7. 管理当地人力资源团队，为团队日常工作提供专业支持与指导。
  8. 负责年度人员编制、人工成本预算及固定资产预算的编制工作。
  9. 监督并管理拉美区域属地化行政工作的开展。
  10. 完成领导临时交办的工作。

任职要求

  • 教育背景 ：本科及以上学历，人力资源或相关管理类专业。
  • 工作经验 ：3年及以上拉美区域人力资源管理工作经验。
  • 知识要求 ：了解基本企业管理知识，熟悉人力资源管理知识，熟悉拉美地区人力资源市场动态及相关劳动政策法规。
  • 基本技能 ：具备一定的写作能力、谈判能力，能够熟练操作计算机办公软件。
  • 核心能力 ：具有较强的计划、组织、协调、分析、沟通、人际交往、语言和文字表达能力。具备出色的跨文化沟通能力及团队协作精神。
  • 特殊要求 ：英语可作为工作语言，有拉美地区人力资源从业经验。
  • 优先条件 ：具备中文语言能力者优先考虑。

title: Analista de planejamento financeiro Sênior
description:
A sua paixão por análise de dados e planejamento financeiro pode ter encontrado o ambiente ideal para crescer!


O time de FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis) de um dos nossos clintes do setor bancário está em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento de modelos, análises e relatórios que suportam a tomada de decisão da empresa.


Neste papel, você será responsável por:

  • Desenvolver e manter modelos de projeção financeira (curto, médio e longo prazo);
  • Elaborar e acompanhar o orçamento anual e realizar o forecast periódico;
  • Criar e aprimorar dashboards e relatórios gerenciais utilizando Excel avançado, Power BI ou ferramentas similares;
  • Realizar análises de variação (real vs. budget/forecast), identificando causas-raiz dos desvios e apresentando insights;
  • Garantir a integridade e consistência dos dados, atuando como um pilar de confiança nas informações gerenciais;
  • Apoiar diretamente a liderança com análises detalhadas e recomendações estratégicas.


O que você precisa para se destacar:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em instituições financeiras, com conhecimento em produtos financeiros de varejo (crédito imobiliário, veículos, entre outros);
  • Domínio em Excel avançado (fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros);
  • Vivência prática em modelagem financeira, projeções e análise de cenários;
  • Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados;
  • Trajetória sólida em processos de budget, forecast e análise de variação;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para traduzir números em insights acionáveis para diferentes áreas.


Perfil comportamental desejado:

  • Analítico e orientado a resultados , com uma mente curiosa para descobrir o “porquê” por trás dos números;
  • Proativo, com iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e otimização de processos;
  • Organizado, metódico e com extrema atenção aos detalhes;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com agilidade sob pressão e cumprir prazos desafiadores;
  • Visão estratégica, sempre conectando as análises aos objetivos de negócio.


Esta oportunidade é para você se:

Você é um(a) profissional que vai além do relatório, buscando o impacto real dos números. Se você combina profundidade técnica em finanças e ferramentas de análise com a capacidade de comunicar ideias de forma eficaz e apoiar decisões, queremos conhecê-lo(a)!


Interessado(a)?

Envie seu currículo ou conecte-se comigo por aqui para uma conversa inicial. Para detalhes mais específicos sobre o escopo da posição, também podemos conectar você diretamente com a gestora da área.

title: Technical Sales Specialist
